_doc: Config for tools/cards/cards.py. Keys starting with _doc are ignored. Every section except hero is optional: omit it and that card is not drawn. Keep text short; screenshot every card to check fit.
title: Project Name
_doc_title: Big display title on the hero. ~12 characters fits best; it auto-scales.
_doc_accent: Darker shade for light mode, brighter shade for dark mode.

hero._doc_masthead: Three small caps labels across the top: left, centre, right.
hero._doc_tagline: Two parts; the second is emphasised.
hero.blurb: One sentence on what the project does and how, under ~110 characters.

demo._doc_demo: The animated card on the right: a question types in, code appears line by line, then result bars grow. Use REAL output from running the project.
demo._doc_labels: Optional. E.g. ["YOU RUN", "IT DOES", "RESULT"] for a CLI.
demo.question: What the user asks or does
demo._doc_keywords: Tokens in code to colour with the accent.
demo._doc_rows: Up to 3 [label, number] pairs; bars scale to the largest.

hero._doc_facts: 3–5 short facts for the strip at the bottom.

arch.alt: Accessible description of the whole diagram.
arch.title: How the pieces fit.
arch._doc_agent: The dark central panel. Holds up to 4 'tools' rows.
arch._doc_links: [tool index, data index] wires from tools to data boxes (0-based).
arch.footnote: One sentence on the most important runtime behaviour.
arch._doc_link: Optional. Label on the dashed client → server wire (default SSE), e.g. HTTP, WS, API.

flow.title: From input to output.
flow._doc_steps: 4–6 [title, caption]; captions wrap at ~24 chars, keep to 2–3 lines.

capabilities.title: Four things it does well.
capabilities._doc_items: Exactly 4 tiles (2×2). 'tool' is shown in a mono chip — a function, endpoint or command.

decisions.title: Why it's built this way.
items: Why, pointing at something real in the code. Up to ~230 characters (two lines).

stack.title: The stack.
stack._doc_cols: Columns of [name, simple-icons slug or null]. Find slugs at https://simpleicons.org. null draws a dot.

terminal.title: Up and running.
terminal._doc_lines: Kinds: cmd (typed after the prompt), com (comment, green), out (dim output), ok (green output), gap (blank). Output must match what really prints. Repeat the commands in a fenced code block in the README so they can be copied.

editor.alt: Accessible description of the code shown.
editor.title: The idea in a few lines.
editor._doc_notes: Line number → note; that line gets highlighted.
editor._doc_lines: [real line number, verbatim code] or ["fold", text] for skipped lines. Python-style highlighting.
